summary: Lease exact ProcessIR inputs from the shared archive library.
details: Live capture requires explicit selection and whole-job resource admission. Candidate and dependency ZIPs use verified same-volume hardlinks with no copy fallback; writable settings, observer files, saves and logs remain private. Existing run and reference outputs are preserved.

Controlled capture-consumer tests use tiny synthetic inputs and a stubbed engine actor. They verify hardlinks, hash custody, repetitions, output accounting and failure refusals; historical ProcessIR proof is retained without claiming a new native or release pass.
